question: Plan a Cosmos Reason 3 DEFT AOI loop over two-image ShareGPT records with bare OK/NG labels. Do not launch anything.
ground_truth: Select tao-run-deft-aoi-cosmos3, ask the user to choose a platform, use nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano unless Edge or Super was explicitly requested, require only Proxy/Benchmark/Mining annotations, start with a zero-shot frozen Benchmark gate and run zero-shot Proxy only when that gate is unmet, both before any training, use Proxy only for RCCA/mining, create train_iter_<N>.json from selected Mining records and AnomalyGen synthetic NG pairs only after RCA, use frozen Benchmark only for stopping, show one preflight gate, and route every later GPU stage through submit/status/logs/cancel with a job-record.
expected_behavior: Identifies tao-run-deft-aoi-cosmos3
Does not default to a platform
Follows the prompt's model choice, defaults to Nano when unspecified, and keeps hardware advice non-binding
Does not request an input Train annotation
Creates train_iter_<N>.json from selected Mining records only after Proxy RCA
Adds AnomalyGen synthetic NG pairs as a second training-data producer alongside real-image mining
Evaluates the frozen Benchmark gate before any Proxy work and skips Proxy once the gate stops the run
Keeps Proxy RCCA and frozen Benchmark stopping separate
Requires exact OK/NG training labels
Does not launch before confirmation

question: Resume the existing Cosmos3 DEFT AOI run at $RESULTS_DIR and determine the only safe next action without launching work.
ground_truth: Read $RESULTS_DIR/deft_state.json as the single source of truth, use its status, current iteration, iteration status, completed stage, and latest event to identify the next stage, then read only that stage reference.
expected_behavior: Reads $RESULTS_DIR/deft_state.json before any stage command
Uses state status, current_iteration, stage_completed, and the latest event to identify progress
Reads only the next stage's reference before later work
Does not mutate files or launch a job

question: Explain how the skill handles a mined record labeled 'Final answer: NG' and whether Benchmark false accepts may be used as mining targets.
ground_truth: Reject the record as a training label because bare mode requires exactly NG, and forbid all Benchmark sample errors from routing/mining; only Proxy false accepts/rejects may drive those stages.
expected_behavior: Rejects non-exact assistant labels in training data
Permits last-token normalization only for evaluator output
Forbids Benchmark errors from routing or mining
Uses Proxy errors as the only RCCA/mining source

question: Run Simple harness on base Cosmos3-Nano with a fixed 8-class by 4-example grid. Let Cosmos choose search and example tools across multiple rounds. Skip DEFT and do not launch yet.
ground_truth: Route to the inference-only simple-harness-grid32-tools-guidance-native4096 profile. Cosmos owns optional tool decisions; a deterministic runner returns tool images to the same conversation. Ten tool rounds and one final-only turn. Require pinned external native source and C-RADIO caches, label-free queries, Mining reference pool, platform record and preflight; no training or model calls for planning.
expected_behavior: Selects inference-only Simple harness route
Cosmos, not Astra, selects tools
No forced search/example sequence
Requires source/model/cache/prompt pins and gold isolation
Does not invoke suite.py, DEFT, SFT or AnomalyGen

question: In Simple harness Cosmos answers immediately. Should the runner force search and class examples first? What if it reaches the tool limit or emits invalid final JSON?
ground_truth: Do not force tools. First non-tool response is saved and terminal even if INVALID. At most ten tool rounds followed by a final-only turn with no tools. No final-format repair or hidden Astra answer. Native4096 and cap128 are distinct profiles; no inherited score claim.
expected_behavior: Accepts zero-tool direct answers
Enforces finite tool rounds
Preserves INVALID without retry
Does not let Astra act for Cosmos

prompt: Let Cosmos search again when class evidence is ambiguous. Add progressive exploration to the grid-and-tools route, preserve native reproduction, and validate only on Proxy. Do not run Benchmark.
ground_truth: Select simple-harness-grid32-explore-cap128-v1. Cosmos owns optional page/tool decisions; no forced replay or Astra choice. Ten tool rounds, cap128. Freeze guidance hash and use separate output. Report new successful search pages and reference IDs separately from duplicate/error retries. No inherited accuracy or Benchmark launch.
